text: On GET /null the SCALE generator and ApacheBench 2.3 agree within 10 % at c = 1, 8 and 32 (median SCALE/ab ratio 0.942, 1.034, 1.015 over 5 repeats); the generator ceiling set by AM-5 is 27919.4 rps.
limitations: One machine; the ceiling includes the server's HTTP path; c=1 ratio 0.942 is below 1

text: Cache (A1) raises peak goodput over the full-scan baseline: geometric mean R = 2.34, 98.75 % interval [2.25, 2.44], 10 blocks.
scope: This workload and implementation (N = 200,000, Zipf 0.99, 2 % writes), closed loop, c 1 to 512
limitations: One machine; A1 peaks at c = 4; cache hit ratio median 0.59

text: Read batching (A3) raises peak goodput: R = 9.01, 98.75 % interval [8.92, 9.09], 10 blocks.
limitations: A3 peaked at the top of the sweep (c = 512) in 3 of 10 blocks, so its G* may be truncated

text: Bounded concurrency (A4) has no meaningful effect on peak goodput: R = 1.015, 98.75 % interval [1.000, 1.030], inside [0.95, 1.05].
limitations: A4 rejects nearly all requests (HTTP 503, error rate about 0.99) from c = 32 upward; peak goodput only

text: The index arm (A2) cannot be compared confirmatorily: its peak (median 28131 rps at c = 2) is generator-limited in every block under the frozen 50 % rule, so the dominance question is unresolved.
evidence: EXP-002 J-0013; analysis.json confirmatory.A2 and dominance
limitations: Exploratory unfiltered R for A2 is about 247; it measures the harness ceiling, not the index alone

text: Among the arms in the confirmatory comparison the order of point estimates is A3 > A1 > A4, and the S3 summary (mean goodput over c in 16, 32, 64) gives the same order for these three arms.
limitations: S3 includes A2 (not generator-limited at c 16 to 64), which then ranks first; no pairwise test among A1, A3, A4 is in the frozen analysis
